steps.title: If … else
steps.body: if (condition) { … } else { … } runs one branch or the other. Conditions compare values: >= at least, <= at most, === equals. Here: 20 coins or more sends rich, otherwise it logs a hint.
steps.task: Add the if/else to the chest block.

steps.title: Wait
steps.body: await wait(2) pauses this block for 2 seconds (the rest of the game keeps running). A block that waits must say async before (e).
steps.task: Make the start block async and wait 2 seconds.

steps.title: Only once
steps.body: once(() => { … }) runs its inside the first time only, however often the block runs. Here the pond message shows the first visit only.
steps.task: Wrap the pond log in once.

steps.title: Random numbers
steps.body: random(min, max) gives a whole number from min to max. The chest now gives 1 to 3 coins.
steps.task: Use random(1, 3) in the chest block.

steps.title: And, or, not
steps.body: && is and, || is or, ! is not. Each comparison sits in its own parentheses.
steps.task: Make the condition: at least 20 and at most 30.

steps.title: Gates
steps.body: gate("name", open, () => { … }) only lets its inside run while the gate is open; gate.open("name") and gate.close("name") switch it from anywhere. The pond's door opens once you are rich.
steps.task: Add the door gate in the pond block and open it from the rich block.
